description: Give each skill only to the agents, models and projects that should have it, so image skills reach Codex and stay out of Claude Code. Each skill carries a list of agents plus optional model and project globs such as gpt-5* or *my-org/*, and a thread receives only the skills that match its agent, model and project. A preview shows what a thread on any agent, model and project would get. Import skill folders from the BB machine, or ask a thread to list or change a scope; a bb scoped-skills CLI does the same. Needs no account, API key or network access.
